(50-100 words describing core contributions)

## Verification Requirements
### For Papers
- [ ] Published in top-tier venue (CCF A/B or JCR Q1/Q2)
- [ ] Open-source implementation available

### For Code
- [ ] Reproduces paper results (±1% accuracy)
- [ ] Provides pretrained weights
- [ ] Unit test coverage ≥ 85%

### For Datasets
- [ ] Clear usage license
- [ ] Minimum 1k annotated instances
- [ ] Provides annotation samples

**Benchmark Results**: (Optional performance metrics)

**Unique Value**: (How this improves existing collection)
